_doc: Machine-local settings live in ~/.config/slop-store/config.json (or $STORE_CONFIG) and override these.
publish_enabled is read ONLY from the machine-local file; a value here is refused, so no commit can switch publishing on.
Owner identity (name, email, logins, hostnames) is never written here: the scrubber reads it at run time.

decisions._doc: The owner's decisions (2026-11-11, relayed by the coordinator). Values: include, exclude/redact (replaced), hold (not published, the unit still is), undecided (the unit waits).

models._doc: Models whose terms were read. A batch or session with any call from a model not under 'verified' is held (store.py check_models).

verified.zai-glm-5-3-flash: Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash served by Mistral: open weights MIT (huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash, LICENSE read 2026-11-11; Mistral's id matched to it by name); Mistral Commercial Terms s.3.1: the customer owns Output
verified.deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 served by Mistral: MIT (huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, card and LICENSE read 2026-11-11); Mistral Commercial Terms s.3.1
verified.fake-*: the verification fake model server: no provider, no model output

unverified.ministral-*-latest: which Ministral release '-latest' serves was not established (Ministral 3 is Apache-2.0; Ministral-8B-2410 is the Mistral Research License)
unverified.mistral-small-latest: the release and licence behind Mistral's '-latest' alias were not read
unverified.gpt-6-luna: a private endpoint's model; its provider terms were not read
